key.name: inner-gaps
key.summary: Gap between adjacent tiles, in pixels

key.name: outer-gaps
key.summary: Gap between tiles and the monitor edge, in pixels

key.name: tile-focused-window
key.summary: Tile the focused window into the current layout, unmaximizing it first if needed

key.name: untile-focused-window
key.summary: Remove the focused window from the tiled layout, leaving it floating in place

key.name: resize-left
key.summary: Move the shared divider left, keeping the opposite screen edge fixed

key.name: resize-right
key.summary: Move the shared divider right, keeping the opposite screen edge fixed

key.name: resize-up
key.summary: Move the shared divider up, keeping the opposite screen edge fixed

key.name: resize-down
key.summary: Move the shared divider down, keeping the opposite screen edge fixed

key.name: per-monitor-workspaces-enabled
key.summary: Give each monitor its own independent, switchable set of virtual workspaces

key.name: deny-fullscreen-on-open
key.summary: Force a newly-created window that opens fullscreen or maximized back into the tiled layout instead of covering the whole screen unmanaged

key.name: virtual-workspace-next
key.summary: Switch the current monitor's active virtual workspace to the next slot (mirrors GNOME's native workspace-switch-right/down accelerators)

key.name: virtual-workspace-prev
key.summary: Switch the current monitor's active virtual workspace to the previous slot (mirrors GNOME's native workspace-switch-left/up accelerators)

key.name: move-window-to-virtual-workspace-next
key.summary: Move the focused tiled window to the next virtual workspace slot on its monitor (mirrors GNOME's native move-to-workspace-right/down accelerators)

key.name: move-window-to-virtual-workspace-prev
key.summary: Move the focused tiled window to the previous virtual workspace slot on its monitor (mirrors GNOME's native move-to-workspace-left/up accelerators)

key.name: switch-to-virtual-workspace-1
key.summary: Switch the focused monitor's active virtual workspace to slot 1, if it exists
